title: Relief valve operation.
officialText:
Relief valves shall be set to discharge at not more than 1½ times the maximum working pressure of the
system. The discharge from relief valves shall be returned to the storage tank or to the supply line. Shutoff valves are not permitted in the
line of relief.
SECTION MC 1308
